Container.Name: DeployCat
Container.Overview: DeployCat is a game server manager that makes it easy to create, configure, and manage multiple game servers from a web interface. Supports Minecraft (Java + Bedrock), Steam games (ARK, The Isle, Rust, Palworld, Satisfactory, CS2, Valheim, V Rising, and 25+ more), with SteamCMD pre-installed and automatic UPnP port forwarding. Free 3-day trial, then paid subscription required.

Config.Name: Data Location
Config.Description: Where DeployCat stores ALL data (servers, config, backups, SteamCMD, Java, logs). Single mount point.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the DeployCat web interface.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership. Default 99 (nobody) matches Unraid convention.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership. Default 100 (users) matches Unraid convention.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for scheduling (backup schedules, start/stop schedules), e.g. America/New_York. Without this, schedules run in UTC.

Config.Name: Host IP
Config.Description: Optional: Your Unraid server's LAN IP. Shown in DeployCat so you know what IP players use to connect.

Config.Name: Host Tailscale Socket
Config.Description: If your Unraid host runs Tailscale, map its socket directory here so DeployCat uses the host's daemon instead of spawning a conflicting one. Leave default if unsure. Only needed when host networking is enabled AND the host runs Tailscale.

Config.Name: TS_SOCKET
Config.Description: Path to the host's Tailscale daemon socket. Only used when Host Tailscale Socket is mapped. This lets DeployCat control the host's Tailscale (auth, status, connect) without running a duplicate daemon.
